# ImageFix

ImageFix is a free online image resizer and image compressor for preparing images for online forms, applications, examinations, and other digital requirements.

## Main Tools

- [Image Resizer](https://compress-image-d8g.pages.dev/image-resizer)
- [Image Compressor](https://compress-image-d8g.pages.dev/image-compressor)

## Image Compression Tools

- [Compress Image to 20KB](https://compress-image-d8g.pages.dev/compress-image-to-20kb)
- [Compress Image to 50KB](https://compress-image-d8g.pages.dev/compress-image-to-50kb)
- [Compress Image to 100KB](https://compress-image-d8g.pages.dev/compress-image-to-100kb)

## Photo Resizers

- [Passport Photo Resizer](https://compress-image-d8g.pages.dev/passport-photo-resizer)
- [Signature Resizer](https://compress-image-d8g.pages.dev/signature-resizer)
- [SSC Photo Resizer](https://compress-image-d8g.pages.dev/ssc-photo-resizer)
- [UPSC Photo Resizer](https://compress-image-d8g.pages.dev/upsc-photo-resizer)

## Privacy

Image processing is performed directly in the user's browser. Images do not need to be uploaded to a server for resizing or compression.
